seo_title: Gold Christmas Decorations Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Gold Christmas decorations for the tree, the table and the front door: glittering wreaths, garlands, candle holders and light-up pieces. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Warm, glowing and endlessly festive. Our gold Christmas decorations bring a touch of candlelight to every corner of the house.
body:
Gold has been part of Christmas for as long as anyone can remember. It catches the glow of fairy lights and candles, warms up evergreen branches and makes even a simple table feel like an occasion. This edit brings together every gold piece in the shop, from glittering wreaths and garlands to candle holders, tree toppers and light-up gift boxes, so you can build a look in one place.

**Choosing your gold.** Not all golds are the same. Bright, glittering gold feels celebratory and suits a classic red and green Christmas or a party-ready table. Softer champagne and brushed gold feel more relaxed and modern, and sit beautifully against white, ivory and natural linen. Mixing two or three tones of gold looks considered rather than matchy, as long as one tone leads.

**Where gold works best.** On the tree, gold baubles and a gold topper make the lights look richer. On the mantel, a pre-lit gold garland gives an instant glow without extra wiring. At the table, gold candle holders lift the setting and look lovely in photos. At the front door, a gold-accented wreath welcomes guests before they've even stepped inside.

**Pairing gold with other colours.** Gold and deep green is timeless. Gold and burgundy feels rich and grown-up. Gold with white and ivory reads soft and elegant, and gold with black is striking and modern. If you're unsure, let gold be the accent and repeat it two or three times around the room so it feels intentional.

**Caring for gold pieces.** Dust gently with a soft, dry brush, keep glittered pieces out of strong afternoon sun, and pack them away wrapped in tissue so the finish stays bright for next year. Every piece here is delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: White Christmas Decorations Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: White and snowy Christmas decorations: frosted wreaths and garlands, snow-tipped trees, white light-up pieces and soft tree skirts. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Soft, wintry and quietly elegant. White Christmas decorations bring a snowy feel to an Australian summer Christmas.
body:
A white Christmas is the stuff of carols and card scenes, and while snow is rare in an Australian December, the look is easy to bring home. This edit gathers every white piece in the shop: frosted and snow-tipped wreaths and garlands, flocked and snowy trees, white light-up decorations, soft tree skirts and more.

**Why white works.** White decorations feel calm and fresh, which suits the light, bright rooms of an Australian summer. They make greenery look crisper, let warm white fairy lights glow, and work with almost any interior, from coastal and Hamptons to modern and Scandinavian.

**Building a white look.** Start with one hero piece, such as a snow-tipped tree or a frosted wreath on the front door. Then add texture rather than more colour: knitted or faux fur tree skirts, linen, glass and soft white lights. Texture stops an all-white scheme from feeling flat. A little natural timber or a touch of silver keeps it from feeling cold.

**White with other colours.** White and silver is classic winter wonderland. White and gold feels warm and celebratory. White with soft green and natural tones feels relaxed and organic, and white with red is crisp and traditional. Choose one partner colour and repeat it around the room.

**Lighting a white scheme.** Warm white lights keep a white look cosy, while cool white lights make it feel icy and wintry. Pre-lit snowy garlands and wreaths are an easy way to add glow without extra cords.

**Caring for snowy pieces.** Flocked and snow-tipped decorations can shed a little the first time they're unpacked, so give them a gentle shake outside. Store them loosely wrapped in a cotton bag or old sheet rather than plastic, somewhere cool and dry. Every piece is delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Red Christmas Decorations Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Red Christmas decorations for a classic, joyful Christmas: red bow wreaths, berry garlands, nutcrackers, candle jars and table linen. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Bold, joyful and full of tradition. Red Christmas decorations bring the warmth of a classic Christmas to every room.
body:
Nothing says Christmas quite like red. It's the colour of holly berries, velvet bows, Santa's coat and the stockings hung by the fire. This edit brings together every red piece in the shop, from red bow wreaths and berry garlands to nutcrackers, candle jars, tea towels and table linen, so you can create a classic Christmas without hunting through every category.

**Choosing your red.** Bright cherry red feels cheerful and playful, perfect for family Christmases and homes with children. Deeper reds, from scarlet to burgundy, feel richer and more grown-up. Using two shades together, such as a bright red bow with deep red berries, adds depth and looks less like a matching set.

**Where to use red.** A red bow on the front door wreath sets the tone before guests arrive. Red baubles and ribbon on a green tree are timeless. At the table, red napkins or a poinsettia tablecloth make the setting instantly festive. In the kitchen, red Christmas tea towels and oven mitts are a small change that makes the whole room feel seasonal.

**Red with other colours.** Red and green is the classic pairing. Red and gold feels luxurious, red and white feels crisp and Scandinavian, and red with tartan and timber feels cosy and traditional. Keep the rest of the palette simple and let red be the hero.

**A little goes a long way.** Red is a strong colour, so you don't need much of it. Repeat it three or four times around a room, on the tree, the mantel, the table and the door, and it will feel considered rather than overwhelming.

**Caring for red pieces.** Keep fabric and ribbon pieces out of strong direct sun, which can fade reds over time, and store them clean and dry. Every piece is delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Black Christmas Decorations Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Black Christmas decorations for a modern, striking Christmas: black and gold candle jars, nutcrackers, festoon lights and statement pieces. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Modern, striking and unexpectedly festive. Black Christmas decorations add drama and contrast to a contemporary home.
body:
Black might not be the first colour you think of at Christmas, but it's one of the most stylish. Used well, it makes gold glow brighter, makes white feel crisper and gives a traditional Christmas a modern edge. This edit brings together every piece in the shop that features black, from black and gold candle jars and nutcrackers to festoon lights and statement decorations.

**Why black works.** Black gives the eye somewhere to rest. In a room full of greenery, lights and baubles, a few black accents add contrast and structure, so the overall look feels sharp and intentional rather than busy. It suits modern homes, monochrome interiors and anyone who loves a moody, candlelit evening.

**Black and gold.** This is the most popular pairing for good reason. Gold looks richer against black, and the combination feels glamorous without being fussy. Think black candle jars with gold detailing on the mantel, or a black-and-gold table setting for Christmas Eve.

**Black and white.** Crisp and graphic, black and white works beautifully with lots of greenery and warm white lights. It feels modern, clean and very photogenic.

**Black with red.** Black and red together feels bold and theatrical, especially with tartan, nutcrackers and velvet ribbon. Keep the rest of the room simple so these colours can shine.

**How much black to use.** Treat black as an accent, not the main colour. A few pieces repeated around a room, such as candle jars, a nutcracker by the door and black ribbon on the tree, is usually enough. Balance it with plenty of warm light so the room still feels cosy.

**Caring for black pieces.** Dust gently with a soft cloth, as dust shows more on dark finishes, and pack them away wrapped in tissue. Every piece is delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Silver Christmas Decorations Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Silver Christmas decorations for a frosty, elegant Christmas: silver tree toppers, glitter picks, light-up gift box stacks and more. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Cool, sparkling and elegant. Silver Christmas decorations bring a frosty, wintry shimmer to the tree and the house.
body:
Silver has a frosty, moonlit quality that makes it perfect for Christmas. It catches the light differently from gold, cooler and crisper, and brings a wintry sparkle to the tree, the mantel and the table. This edit gathers every silver piece in the shop, from glittering tree toppers and poinsettia picks to light-up gift box stacks and cotton ball lights.

**Why choose silver.** Silver suits white, grey and blue schemes beautifully and feels calm and elegant. It's a lovely choice for a winter wonderland look, a modern monochrome home, or anyone who prefers a softer alternative to gold.

**Building a silver look.** Start with silver and white baubles on a green or snow-tipped tree, then add a silver star topper. Bring texture in with faux fur, glass and soft knitted throws, and repeat silver on the mantel with candlesticks or lanterns. Grey cushions and silver wrapping paper with white or black ribbon finish the look under the tree.

**Silver with other colours.** Silver and white is classic and wintry. Silver and blue feels icy and dramatic. Silver with soft grey and natural timber feels relaxed and Scandinavian, while silver with deep green keeps things traditional. Mixing silver and gold is fine too, as long as one leads and the other is an accent.

**Lighting a silver scheme.** Cool white lights make silver sparkle and feel icy. Warm white lights soften it and make the room feel cosier. Both work, so choose the mood you want.

**Caring for silver pieces.** Keep glittered pieces dry, dust them gently with a soft brush and store them wrapped in tissue paper, away from heat and humidity, so they keep their shine for years. Handled with a little care, good silver pieces become part of your family Christmas for many seasons. Every piece is delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Natural Christmas Decorations Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Natural Christmas decorations in timber, linen and earthy tones: pine cone garlands, linen tree skirts, wrapping and gifts. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Earthy, relaxed and timeless. Natural Christmas decorations bring the textures of the outdoors inside for Christmas.
body:
A natural Christmas is all about texture and warmth: pine cones, linen, timber, kraft paper and soft earthy tones. It feels relaxed rather than glitzy, suits Australian homes beautifully and looks just as good on Boxing Day as it did on Christmas Eve. This edit brings together every piece in the shop with natural tones and textures, from pine cone garlands and linen tree skirts to wrapping and gifts.

**Why a natural look works.** Natural decorations feel calm and grounded, and they sit happily alongside timber floors, rattan furniture, linen and indoor plants. They're also very forgiving, because natural tones work together without much planning.

**Building a natural Christmas.** Start with greenery: a full green tree, a pine cone garland on the mantel or a wreath on the door. Add texture with linen or knitted tree skirts, rattan ball lights and natural ribbon. Wrap gifts in kraft paper with twine or linen ribbon for a look that ties the whole room together.

**Adding colour.** A natural scheme is a lovely base for small touches of colour. Deep red berries feel traditional, soft white feels Scandinavian, and a little gold adds warmth for the evening. Keep additions to one colour so the look stays relaxed.

**An Australian twist.** Eucalyptus, gum leaves and native-inspired pieces sit beautifully in a natural scheme and give Christmas a distinctly Australian feel. Pair them with warm white lights for long summer evenings.

**Caring for natural pieces.** Keep linen and fabric pieces clean and completely dry before packing them away, store garlands loosely so pine cones and berries keep their shape, and choose a cool, dry cupboard rather than a hot garage or roof space. A natural Christmas only gets better with time, as each year's pieces add to the last. Every piece is delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Gold Christmas Wreaths & Garlands | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Gold Christmas wreaths and garlands, many pre-lit: glittery gold pine, gold baubles, gold poinsettias and more for the door and mantel. Delivered Australia-wide.
intro: Glittering gold wreaths and garlands for the front door, the mantel and the staircase, many with lights already built in.
body:
A gold wreath on the front door or a gold garland along the mantel is one of the quickest ways to make a house feel like Christmas. Gold catches the light at every time of day, sunlight in the afternoon and fairy lights after dark, and it pairs beautifully with greenery. This edit brings together every gold wreath and garland in the shop, from glittery gold pine and gold-tipped branches to gold baubles, berries and poinsettias.

**Pre-lit or unlit.** Many of these pieces come pre-lit, with warm white LEDs already woven through, so there's no untangling or extra cords to hide. Battery-operated designs are perfect for doors and mantels without a nearby power point. Unlit wreaths and garlands give you the freedom to add your own lights or ribbon.

**Choosing a wreath for your door.** Measure your door first. A 60 cm wreath suits most standard front doors, while larger doors and double doors can take a bigger or more generous design. If your door is dark, a gold wreath will really stand out; on a white or pale door, choose one with plenty of green to frame the gold.

**Dressing a mantel with a garland.** Let a garland run a little past each end of the mantel for a relaxed, generous look. Add candles at different heights and repeat the gold with a candle holder or two. For a staircase, wind a garland along the banister and secure it with soft ties.

**Mixing gold with other colours.** Gold and green is timeless, gold with red berries is traditional, and gold with white feels soft and elegant. Repeat the same colours on the tree so the whole house feels connected.

**Outdoor use and care.** Hang outdoor wreaths in a sheltered spot, under an awning or a covered porch, away from strong sun and storms. Store them flat or hanging in a large bag so they keep their shape. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Red Christmas Wreaths & Garlands | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Red Christmas wreaths and garlands with bows, berries and blooms, many pre-lit, for a classic front door and mantel. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Classic red bows, berries and blooms. Red Christmas wreaths and garlands give your front door and mantel a traditional welcome.
body:
A wreath with a big red bow is the most classic Christmas welcome there is. Red berries, amaryllis blooms and velvet bows against deep green branches look festive from the street and cheerful up close. This edit gathers every red wreath and garland in the shop, so you can find the one that suits your door, mantel or staircase.

**Finding your style.** A simple green wreath with a single red bow feels traditional and timeless. Wreaths with red berries and pine cones feel rustic and natural. Designs with red blooms, such as amaryllis, feel abundant and luxurious, and pre-decorated wreaths with baubles are a ready-made shortcut for a busy December.

**Sizing your wreath.** A 60 cm wreath suits most front doors. For a smaller door, a window or an internal door, choose a more compact design. For a grand entrance, go generous, or hang a matching wreath on each side of a double door.

**Garlands for the mantel and stairs.** A red berry garland along the mantel ties in beautifully with stockings and candles. On a staircase, wind a garland along the banister and add red ribbon every metre or so for a classic finishing touch.

**Pre-lit pieces.** Many of these wreaths and garlands have warm white LEDs built in, often battery-operated with timers, so they come on at dusk without any effort and there are no cords to run to a power point.

**Repeat the red.** For a house that feels connected, repeat the red from your wreath somewhere inside: ribbon on the tree, napkins at the table or a red candle on the mantel.

**Caring for your wreath.** Keep outdoor wreaths under cover where possible, as strong sun can fade red ribbons and berries over time. Store them hanging or flat in a bag, somewhere cool and dry. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: White & Snowy Christmas Wreaths & Garlands | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: White, frosted and snow-tipped Christmas wreaths and garlands, many pre-lit, for a wintry front door and mantel. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Frosted, snow-tipped and softly glowing. White Christmas wreaths and garlands bring a wintry welcome to an Australian summer.
body:
Snowy wreaths and garlands give an Australian Christmas a little winter magic. Frosted tips, white flocking and snowflake details look soft and elegant against any door colour, and they pair beautifully with white, silver, gold or natural schemes. This edit brings together every white and snowy wreath and garland in the shop.

**Snow-tipped or fully flocked.** Snow-tipped designs keep plenty of green showing, with frosted tips that suggest a light dusting of snow. Fully flocked or snowflake designs feel whiter and more wintry. Snow-tipped pieces are the most versatile, while flocked pieces make the strongest statement.

**Pre-lit for a soft glow.** Many of these wreaths and garlands come with warm white LEDs already in place. The lights make the frosted tips glow beautifully after dark. Battery-operated designs are ideal for front doors and mantels without a power point nearby, and many include timers.

**Styling a white wreath.** On a dark door, a snowy wreath looks crisp and striking. On a white door, choose one with more green so it doesn't disappear. Add a velvet or linen ribbon in your accent colour: silver for a winter wonderland, red for something traditional, or natural linen for a relaxed look.

**Garlands for mantels and stairs.** A snowy garland along the mantel looks lovely with white candles, glass lanterns and silver accents. Wind one along a staircase or above a doorway for a wintry feel throughout the house.

**Caring for snowy pieces.** Flocking can shed a little when first unpacked, so give each piece a gentle shake outside. Hang outdoor wreaths under cover, away from rain and strong sun. Store them loosely wrapped in a cotton bag or old sheet rather than plastic, somewhere cool and dry, and they'll bring the same wintry welcome for many Christmases to come. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Green Christmas Wreaths & Garlands | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Lush green Christmas wreaths and garlands in pine, spruce and cashmere styles, plain or decorated, many pre-lit. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Lush, evergreen and endlessly versatile. Green Christmas wreaths and garlands are the foundation of every festive home.
body:
Evergreen wreaths and garlands are where Christmas decorating begins. A lush green wreath on the door or a full garland along the mantel instantly makes a house feel festive, and green works with every colour scheme you might choose. This edit brings together every green wreath and garland in the shop, from plain pine and spruce to decorated, pre-lit and snow-dusted designs.

**Plain or decorated.** A plain green wreath or garland is the most versatile choice. Dress it with your own ribbon, berries or baubles and change the look each year. Decorated designs, with berries, pine cones, baubles or blooms already added, are a beautiful shortcut when time is short.

**Choosing a greenery style.** Long needle pine feels soft and natural. Cashmere and spruce styles feel full and lush, and mixed greenery looks relaxed and abundant. Look closely at the photos to see how full each design is, as a generous wreath or garland always looks more expensive.

**Pre-lit options.** Many of these pieces come with warm white LEDs built in. They're perfect for mantels, doors and staircases, and battery-operated designs mean no cords to run. Lights make greenery look fuller and richer after dark.

**Making it your own.** Add a velvet bow for something classic, linen ribbon for a relaxed look, or gold baubles for a touch of glamour. Repeat the same ribbon or accent colour on your tree so the whole house feels connected.

**Sizing tips.** A 60 cm wreath suits most front doors. For a mantel garland, choose a length that runs a little past each end. For a staircase, measure the banister and allow a little extra for draping.

**Care and storage.** Hang outdoor pieces under cover where possible, reshape branches each year, and store wreaths flat or hanging and garlands loosely coiled, somewhere cool and dry. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: White & Snow-Tipped Christmas Trees Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: White, frosted and snow-tipped Christmas trees, many pre-lit, from tabletop to full size, for a wintry Christmas. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Frosted, snow-tipped and beautifully lit. White Christmas trees bring a wintry, elegant feel to the heart of the home.
body:
A snow-tipped or white Christmas tree brings winter magic indoors, even in the height of an Australian summer. Frosted branches look soft and elegant, need very little decorating, and suit white, silver, gold and natural schemes beautifully. This edit gathers every white and snowy tree in the shop, from tabletop trees to full-size statement pieces.

**Snow-tipped, frosted or white.** Snow-tipped trees keep plenty of green, with frosted tips that look like a light fall of snow. Frosted trees feel softer and whiter. Fully white and light-up branch trees make a modern, sculptural statement and look striking in a corner or entryway.

**Pre-lit trees.** Many of these trees come with warm white LEDs already in place, evenly spaced through the branches. The lights make frosted tips glow and save time on decorating. Some include multiple light modes and timers.

**Choosing a size.** Measure your ceiling and allow about 30 cm for a topper and breathing space. A 1.5 m tree suits smaller living rooms and apartments, while a 1.8 m to 2.1 m tree suits most standard ceilings. Tabletop and small trees are lovely on a sideboard, in a bedroom or at the office. Our [Christmas tree calculator](/christmas-calculator) can help.

**Decorating a snowy tree.** Because a snowy tree already looks finished, keep decorations simple. Silver and white baubles create a classic winter wonderland, gold feels warm and celebratory, and natural pine cones and timber feel relaxed. Finish with a knitted or faux fur tree skirt.

**Caring for your tree.** Flocking can shed a little when the tree is first set up, so shape the branches over an old sheet. Keep the tree out of strong afternoon sun, and store it in a bag or box somewhere cool and dry after Christmas. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Green Christmas Trees Australia | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Artificial green Christmas trees in full, tabletop and pre-lit styles, from 60 cm to 2.1 m, for every room. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Full, lush and classic. Green Christmas trees in every size, from tabletop to tall, pre-lit or ready for your own lights.
body:
A full green tree is the heart of a traditional Christmas. It's where the presents gather, where the family decorates together and where the lights glow every evening through December. This edit brings together every green tree in the shop, from tabletop trees and small pre-lit trees to full-size trees for living rooms with high ceilings.

**Finding the right height.** Measure from floor to ceiling and allow about 30 cm for a topper and a little space above it. For a standard 2.4 m ceiling, a 1.8 m to 2.1 m tree is usually right. Our [Christmas tree calculator](/christmas-calculator) works it out for you, along with how many lights and baubles you'll need.

**How full is full?** The number of branch tips is the best guide to how lush a tree will look. More tips means a denser, more natural tree that hides the centre pole and holds decorations well. Check each tree's details for its tip count.

**Pre-lit or unlit.** Pre-lit trees have lights already woven through the branches, so there's no untangling and the lights are evenly spaced. Unlit trees give you full control over the colour and style of lights, and are easy to change from year to year.

**Small and tabletop trees.** Not every room needs a big tree. Tabletop and small pre-lit trees are perfect for apartments, entryways, children's bedrooms, offices and kitchens, and many are battery-operated, so they can go anywhere.

**Decorating a green tree.** Green works with every colour scheme. Red and gold is classic, white and silver is wintry, and natural pine cones and timber feel relaxed. Lights first, then garland or ribbon, then baubles from largest to smallest.

**Setting up and storing.** Shape every branch, working from the bottom up, keep the tree out of strong afternoon sun, and pack it away in a bag or box somewhere cool and dry. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Gold Christmas Home Decorations | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Gold Christmas decorations for around the home: light-up gift boxes, candle holders, centrepieces, tree stands and statement pieces. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Gold pieces for every room: light-up gift boxes, candle holders, centrepieces and statement decorations that glow all season.
body:
Christmas isn't just about the tree. A few gold pieces around the house, on a side table, a console, the hallway or the kitchen bench, make the whole home feel festive. This edit gathers every gold decoration for around the home, from light-up gift boxes and stacked centrepieces to candle holders, statement decorations and tree stands.

**Light-up gold pieces.** Illuminated gift boxes, stacked stars and light-up centrepieces add a warm glow to corners the tree can't reach. Many are battery-operated with timers, so they can sit anywhere and come on at dusk without any effort.

**Candle holders and centrepieces.** Gold candle holders add height and glow to a mantel, sideboard or dining table. Group them in odd numbers at different heights, and use LED candles wherever real flames aren't practical or safe.

**Statement pieces.** A single gold statement decoration, such as a tree stand, a metal train or a sculptural piece, can anchor a room and becomes a talking point for guests. Place it somewhere with a little space around it so it can shine.

**Where to put them.** Use the entry hall for a first impression, the living room near the tree to extend the glow, the dining room for candles and centrepieces, and the kitchen bench or a bookshelf for smaller pieces that catch the eye every day.

**Pairing gold with your décor.** Gold sits beautifully with timber, white walls and greenery. With black or deep green interiors it looks rich and dramatic, and with soft neutrals it feels warm and elegant. Repeat gold two or three times in a room so it feels intentional.

**Care and storage.** Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth, remove batteries before storing light-up pieces, and pack decorations in tissue somewhere cool and dry so they're ready for next year. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.

seo_title: Red Christmas Home Decorations | Ivy & Bough
seo_description: Red Christmas decorations for around the home: nutcrackers, candle jars, light-up gift boxes, tea towels and festive pieces. Delivered across Australia.
intro: Cheerful red pieces for every room: nutcrackers, candle jars, light-up gift boxes and festive touches for the kitchen.
body:
A few cheerful red pieces around the house bring the joy of Christmas into every room, not just the one with the tree. This edit gathers every red decoration for around the home, from nutcrackers and candle jars to light-up gift boxes, festive tea towels and oven mitts.

**Nutcrackers and statement pieces.** A tall nutcracker by the front door or the fireplace is a classic Christmas welcome, and children love them. Group two or three of different heights for real impact, or let one stand alone as a statement.

**Candle jars and light-up pieces.** Red candle jars and light-up gift boxes add a warm glow to side tables, shelves and the mantel. Battery-operated designs can go anywhere, and many have timers so they switch on each evening.

**The kitchen and dining room.** Red Christmas tea towels and oven mitts are a small change that makes the kitchen feel festive straight away, and they make lovely gifts. Carry the red through to the dining table with napkins or a centrepiece.

**Where red works best.** Use red as a thread that runs through the house. A red bow on the front door, a nutcracker in the hall, red ribbon on the tree and red napkins at the table make the whole home feel connected.

**Pairing red with your décor.** Red and green is traditional, red and gold feels luxurious, red and white is crisp and Scandinavian, and red with timber and tartan feels cosy. In a modern home, a few red accents against white or grey walls look fresh and striking.

**Care and storage.** Keep fabric pieces out of strong direct sun to stop the red from fading, wash linens before packing them away, remove batteries from light-up pieces, and store everything somewhere cool and dry. Delivered Australia-wide, with free delivery on orders over $150.
